value.text: Welcome to Example Team! This is #general — company-wide announcements only. Please keep discussion in the topic channels.
Reminder: the monthly all-hands is on Thursday at 15:00 UTC.
Heads-up: I'm out Sept 14–16, Sam covers on-call.
<@U01OPSBOT05> has joined the channel
Kicking off the payments-service migration this week. Design doc is in the shared drive.
Great — let's make sure the postgres schema changes are backwards compatible.
I can review the migration scripts tomorrow.
Update for everyone: the migration is scheduled for Thursday's deploy window.
Change ticket CHG-2041 created for the Thursday window.
Deploy checklist for Thursday: freeze at 14:00 UTC, smoke tests, then announce in #general.
Deploy went out cleanly. Error rate flat, p95 latency down 8%.
Postgres 16 upgrade notes are up. Main change: the connection pooler config moves to the new file.
Reminder to write a rollback plan before every production change. Template is pinned in #incidents.
Nightly build #4821 passed (312 tests, 0 failures).
Anyone else seeing flaky results from the integration suite on the ci-runner-3 box?
Fixed the flaky suite — the test container was reusing a port. PR #418 is ready for review.
Next deploy window is Tuesday 2026-09-16. Add your changes to the release sheet by Monday noon.
Morning! Standup moved to 09:30 UTC today because of the incident review.
ALERT: checkout-api error rate above 5% for 10 minutes (INC-77).
On it. Rolling back the 02:00 config change.
Recovered at 02:29. Root cause: a bad feature-flag default. Post-mortem tomorrow.
Incident runbook and rollback template: https://wiki.example.test/runbooks/checkout — please read before your next on-call shift.
Incident review for INC-77 starts at 09:00 UTC in the ops room.
Anyone have a good lunch spot recommendation near the office?
:tada:
<@U01DANA0001> the team photo from the offsite is in the shared album!
Friday reminder: submit your expense reports by end of day.
Q3 launch retrospective notes are in the doc. Thanks everyone!
Archiving this channel now that the launch is done.
New onboarding flow mockups are ready for feedback.
Looks great — the empty state copy could be shorter.
Hiring plan for Q4 draft is ready.
Reviewed. Let's discuss on Wednesday.
Do you have five minutes to talk about the on-call rota?
Sure, calling you now.
Thanks — updated the rota sheet.
Lunch on Friday to celebrate the migration?
Count me in.
